rationale: iter-5: ReLU -> Swish (SiLU). Landed on Quadro RTX 5000 again because the /tmp helper passed --exclude=lme171 on the cmdline, which overrode the in-script exclude. Training finished but validation OOMed at 16GB VRAM (val_n=100 forwarded full-res through 1152x736). Two fixes: (a) drop the cmdline override (helper updated), (b) chunked validation in solver for robustness.
advice_for_others: sbatch --exclude on the cmdline OVERRIDES the in-script #SBATCH --exclude directive; set only one. Full-res residual stacks consume ~16+ GB at val_n=100; chunk validation through pipe.predict().
